params.body:
In the Netwerk relation panel, the second tab was called "Werkt samen met", and each row in it ended with "neemt over: <colleague>". Both phrases are about people working together. That made it unclear whether a name was a partner on site or a GLK colleague taking the relation over.

- The tab is now **Samen op projecten**. It lists the other relations on the same projects, which is all it ever showed.
- The last line of each row now reads **overdracht aan <colleague>**, or **overdracht: nog aan niemand**. It uses the same word as the Overdracht tab beside it, where the takers are chosen.
- The legend under the graph names the tab by its new name.
- The tabs now size to their label: `flex-auto`, and a little less padding on a phone. The longer label still fits beside Overdracht at 390px. The project panel's Overdracht / Relaties switch uses the same classes.

Checked by screenshot on the demo database at 1400px and 390px. The full suite passes (362/362), and NetworkTest now asserts both takers lines.
params.title: Netwerk: name the partners tab 'Samen op projecten' and the takers line 'overdracht aan'
